event.label: Last listed in the directories transcribed so far (1935)

body.p: Banbridge Place is a lane off the west side of Bouverie Street, between the Prince of Wales Hotel and Church Street. In 1885 the directory lists it next to Banbridge Terrace.
It is first listed in the directories in 1885 and last in 1935. It had nine listings in 1885, numbered from 1 to 10, but only two or three in each directory from 1900.

div.head: Along the street
div.p: In the Bouverie Street listings the turn into Banbridge Place comes between Nos 221 and 225 in 1910, a little south of Church Street. Prince of Wales Place is the next lane south.

list.item: The Carlton Free Kindergarten, at No. 233a in 1930 and 1935 (see Kindergartens).

div.head: Records
div.p: Every directory and electoral-roll listing for Banbridge Place can be browsed in search. Each directory year links to its own page from Sands & McDougall Directories.
